ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, we will focus on Latina/o performances from the 1970s to the present in order to highlight the relationship between exercises of everyday life, acts on stage, and media art. In doing so, we will pay particular attention to the material body and bodies of work by scholars of Latina/o Performance Studies. As such, we will critically engage with performance theory, video performances, and theorizations of Latinidad and the body.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign or Professional - Urbana.
